body_html:
The Global Rebound armchair brings a patented flex back to everyday multi-purpose seating, flexing with each shift in posture so people stay comfortable through long meetings, training sessions and waiting-room stretches. Its recyclable polypropylene shell pairs with an upholstered seat cushion for a clean, contemporary look that holds up in high-traffic institutional spaces. With a 400 lb active-weight rating and five-high floor stacking, it is a practical choice for school boards, clinics and busy reception areas.

Features

  • Patented flex back that follows the sitter's movement for responsive, all-day support
  • Recyclable polypropylene shell with an upholstered seat cushion in fabric, vinyl or leather
  • 14 polypropylene shell colours with coordinating frame finishes
  • Stacks five high on the floor and ten high on a dolly for easy storage and room turnover
  • Part of a versatile Rebound family of arm and armless models
  • Warranted to a 400 lb active weight when fitted with glides

Specifications

Overall dimensions are 26.25"W x 20.5"D x 32.75"H. The shell and frame are fully recyclable and GREENGUARD Gold certified, and every Rebound chair is tested to exceed ANSI/BIFMA standards. Backed by a limited lifetime warranty on the frame and components, 12 years on control mechanisms and 5 years on upholstery, foam and mesh.

A Canadian-made Global Furniture Group product from Brant Business Interiors, family-owned since 1964 at 296 George St N, Peterborough ON. As an OECM-eligible supplier, we make it simple for Ontario institutional buyers to purchase without an open tender. Request a Quote or call 1-800-835-9565 for volume pricing and finish options.
